why: Proposal A delivers the Nordic, warm look the client described: light woods, cream textiles and green accents, with a rug sized for the seating area and a 140 cm table that suits the space near the window. Proposal B mixes dark nailhead and ombre pieces, a black-legged table and a heavy turned lamp with the light pieces, so it looks less cohesive. Its 180 cm table, oversized canvas and tiny throw also fit the room less well.
